title: The All-Seeing Submarine
description: A surreal copper-colored metallic submarine shaped like a giant eye with a vivid green iris floats amidst turbulent blue and teal waves. The vessel is adorned with intricate brass gears, rivets, and scattered alphabet letters, while small flowers and ribbons drift in the foreground under a stormy sky with distant industrial structures.
prompt: Surreal scene of a vintage copper submarine designed as a giant mechanical eye with a bright green iris and black pupil, floating on choppy stylized waves. The metallic hull features intricate brass gears, rivets, and scattered colorful alphabet letters. Small flowers and decorative ribbons float in the foreground. Stormy sky with distant industrial structures in the background, whimsical and mysterious atmosphere, detailed painting style.
